_what: The door operations the Workshop's text may tell an AI to call: each [address, method] pair an owner behind the door answers. They come from the engine's own DATA (trillion-rust tool-runs.json `*_method`, wake.json, share-grant.json `door_grant.act` and the secrets operations; the same set its scopes are checked against, D3.1), and the door's own paged read of these instructions (`ai-instruction-settings.read` in rows.json). test-helpers/named-calls.mjs treats any other door call named in shipped text as one nothing answers. The person's own data is not behind the door: it is in the person's own stores, reached with their own connections.
